notes: Add days since last flight/charge to the upload note.
One pack per channel per run, in the order listed; keep each log file.
Rule B: rest V spread across a board <=0.30 V GO, 0.30-0.60 V CAUTION (reduced current), >0.60 V do not parallel.
New series C3/C4 charge individually (new_series_runs) on a separate night from C1/C2 to keep mapping clean; never mix series on a board.
